posts.alt_text: Quote: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached. Swami Vivekananda.
posts.caption:
Don't start and stop. Start and keep going.
Swami Vivekananda's call to action is still the best Monday reminder there is.
What's the one goal you're not stopping for this week? Drop it in the comments.

posts.alt_text: Quote: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit. Will Durant.
posts.caption:
Excellence isn't a big moment. It's a small thing done again and again.
Often credited to Aristotle, these words are Will Durant's summary of Aristotle's ethics in The Story of Philosophy (1926).
Pick one small habit and repeat it today. That's the whole game.

posts.alt_text: Quote: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall. Oliver Goldsmith.
posts.caption:
Falling isn't the failure. Staying down is.
This line is usually credited to Confucius, but Oliver Goldsmith wrote it in The Citizen of the World in the 1760s.
Where are you rising again this week?

posts.alt_text: Quote: Do what you can, with what you've got, where you are. Squire Bill Widener, quoted by Theodore Roosevelt.
posts.caption:
You don't need perfect conditions. You need to start.
Theodore Roosevelt made this line famous in his 1913 autobiography, but he credited it to a Virginia farmer, Squire Bill Widener.
What can you do today with exactly what you have?

posts.alt_text: Quote: Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will. Mahatma Gandhi.
posts.caption:
Real strength is decided in the mind before it shows anywhere else.
Gandhi wrote this in Young India on 11 August 1920.
What will you push through today, just by deciding to?

posts.alt_text: Quote: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how. Friedrich Nietzsche.
posts.caption:
When you know why you're doing something, the hard parts get lighter.
From Nietzsche's Twilight of the Idols (1889).
Write your "why" in one sentence. Keep it somewhere you'll see it every morning.

posts.alt_text: Quote: No longer talk at all about the kind of man that a good man ought to be, but be such. Marcus Aurelius.
posts.caption:
Less talking about who we should be. More being it.
Marcus Aurelius wrote this note to himself nearly 1,900 years ago in his Meditations.
